title: Type B real-rootedness conjecture for the polynomials $B_n$
statement: Let $B_n$ be the type B polynomials defined in the paper, for $n\geq 1$. A polynomial is **real-rooted** if all of its roots are real. **Type B real-rootedness conjecture.** For all $n\geq 1$, the polynomials $B_n$ are real-rooted. The preceding corollary establishes that the polynomials $B_n$ are $\gamma$-positive, and real-rootedness would further imply $\gamma$-positivity and ultra log-concavity for palindromic polynomials with nonnegative coefficients; the source gives no resolution status for this type B analogue.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01956

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2026).
source_name: Luis Ferroni, Roberto Pagaria and Lorenzo Vecchi, “The Poincaré polynomial of the type B analogue of M_0,n+1”, arXiv:2603.01956 (2026).
